Analysis of a dainty silver chrismarium webbed in rainbow glaes filaments indicates the creator has provided the following information:

This is a chrismarium, a holy relic that stores the oil and balsam from inside a chrism gem, allowing you to stockpile multiple charges inside for later application to a corpse.  While anyone may add chrism oil to it, it may only be used by clerics to apply the chrism effect.
It may be altered but must remain made of metal, and the noun must remain chrismarium.
This chrismarium is at tier 4 out of 5.  It cannot be unlocked further outside of extraordinarily rare events.
It will hold a maximum of 80 charges.
It is currently using the "Rude" messaging style.

You can PUSH the chrismarium with a chrism in your other hand to store it within.  This destroys the chrism and adds one charge to the chrismarium.  The charges within the chrismarium are as effective as the average of all chrism gems absorbed in this fashion.
You can PROD the chrismarium to stop being warned about when chrism's quality would reduce the average of the chrismarium's contents.
These warnings only apply to the 'fullness' of chrisms and none of their other qualities.

You can POUR the chrismarium on a player to grant them its effects, provided you are skilled in using chrisms.  You can also POUR it on the ground, which wastes a charge but may be useful if you want to replace the contents with higher-quality chrisms.
Unlocked verbs: PUSH, POUR, LOOK, MEASURE, RUB, PROD, PONDER, TILT, RAISE
The dainty silver chrismarium will cost 20,000,000 coins.

raw: The gossamer thread constantly unravels and reforms in a mesmerizing dance.  Though entirely insubstantial, the otherworldly strand somehow retains its shape as its essence ripples with a strange, innate responsiveness.
It is currently tier 1 out of 5.  It is empowered by 1 thread.
The vissi can not be worn.
It looks like this item has been mainly crafted out of organic material, an extremely common material.
Analysis of a Higher Self vissi indicates the creator has provided the following information:

The Higher Self vissi can be added to a vissi artifact in order to augment the artifact with custom abilities.  Each vissi artifact may hold up to 5 different types of vissi, and each vissi may be upgradable by adding additional vissi of the same type to the artifact.
The Higher Self vissi is named Higher Self and it is a Chimera vissi.
This vissi notes the following ability information:
Reflect upon and embrace your inner peace and positive goals alongside your companion vissi.

The vissi may have abilities you can activate by using certain verbs (RUB, TAP, PUSH, PULL, or POKE) on the vissi artifact you add them to.  In order to set the activator, use ATTEND on the vissi.  The vissi might not have an ability you may activate, in which case ATTEND will indicate that.

Sometimes, a vissi may have multiple abilities you can activate with the activator verbs.  You can TILT the vissi to switch between them.  Tilt will not respond if the vissi has only a single ability (or no abilities at all).  You may only have one ability active at a time.

In addition, the vissi may have abilities with customizable messaging options.  You can TURN the vissi to customize each set of options.  Once on a set of options, you can TWIST the vissi to cycle through the available customizations.
Finally, some vissi may contain ambient messaging, which you can toggle on or off with COVER.
It is currently tier 1 out of 5.  It is empowered by 1 thread.
The Higher Self vissi will cost 65,000 coins.

Analysis of a slender faenor quiver etched with a latticework of ivy indicates the creator has provided the following information:
~Compartmentalized Quiver~
Compartmentalized quivers keep your ammo collection neat, tidy, and all in one place!
~General Script Info~
* Once unlocked, these quivers gain access to weightless extra compartments to store ammo bundles.
* Only the currently selected compartment's contents will count towards encumbrance.
* Each compartment only holds 1 bundle.
* Use READY AMMO on the quiver itself and it will use whichever bundle is in the current compartment when you FIRE.
* Quivers can be shoulder, belt, or thigh-worn.
~Alteration Guidelines~
* Alterations to the 15/15/15 and long description are fine, though shows are not possible.
* Quivers MUST be made of metal and have the noun 'quiver'.
* You may NOT describe the quiver's wear location, such as using the words belt or thigh.
~Unlock Status~
This quiver is currently unlocked once (Tier 2 of 3).
At this tier, you have access to the verbs: RUB, CLEAN, GET, DROP/PUT, NUDGE, TINKER, TURN, TOUCH.
You can use INSPECT to see the configuration of the compartments and their contents.
~Features~
* Weightless Compartments
Extra compartments for this quiver will hold ammo weightlessly.
This quiver currently has a total of 4 compartments out of a maximum of 4.
- TURN the quiver to switch compartments, as only the current one will let you use the ammo.
- The quiver will automatically use the ammo in the current compartment when FIREing.
* Ammo Display
Use TOUCH to toggle including the current ammo in the quiver's description.
~Custom Description~
Your quiver's article is currently set to a/an slender.
Your quiver's custom long description is: etched with a latticework of ivy.
This quiver cannot be lightened or deepened.
The faenor quiver will cost 40,000,000 coins.

Analysis of a fairywing moth cloak of berry-hued damask indicates the creator has provided the following information:
~*~ Moth Cloaks ~*~

This cloak is a butterfly/moth cloak with several randomizing points to create multiple unique looks with a single PUSH.  It is Tier 5 out of 5, and it is set to the moth setting.  It is set to NOT rotate with day/night changes.  You can APPROVE to toggle this setting.
The cloak features an encumbrance reduction (3x/day, 15 minutes each RUB, resets at midnight server time.  There are 3 charges left today.
Utilities:
* APPROVE:  rotates through "moth only," "butterfly only," or "adjust with day/night"
* CLEAN:  will clear the selected, stored look
* POKE: takes your randomized look and saves it in 1 of the 2 available stored slots
* PUSH - replaces your randomized look
* TURN - rotates through all saved looks (current randomized look, any stored randomized looks, the custom look, if applicable)
* RUB - activates the encumbrance reduction.
Unlocked Fluff Verbs:  observe, tickle, eat, flip, hug, raise, bow, curtsy, brush, touch, and wave
*  WAVE has some "drama llama" options for you!  Try WAVE CLOAK WITH (anger, drama, joy, mystery, or sorrow)
Alterations:
* Base:  must be simple, as it carries across all looks.  The noun must be in the hooded cloak family.
* Material:  must be a type of cloth.  This carries across all looks.
* Colors cannot be referenced in the base or material fields, as colors change based on the settings.
* Custom settings:  The alter points must be provided in this specific order:

** "butterfly adjective^wingtype^forewing color^forewing marking^forewing marking color^forewing marking location^hindwing color^hindwing marking^hinding marking color^hindwing markinglocation^special*moth adjective^wingtype^forewing color^forewing marking^forewing marking color^forewing marking location^hindwing color^hindwing marking^hinding marking color^hindwing marking location^special
** The total character count must be 511 or less
** Moth/Butterfly Adjective alter point must be 15 characters or less.  No a/an needed.
** See the wiki for in-depth information and examples at https://gswiki.play.net/Moth_Cloak
* Custom Look 1 (Butterfly):  You can provide a SHOW for your custom setting.  It cannot contradict the alter points selected for the custom settings.
* Custom Look 2 (Moth):  Same as butterfly, but for the moth version.

* Doing a custom setting is 1 alteration service, as is each custom look (so a custom setting, butterfly look, and moth look are 3 separate alterations.  This is because each one is fairly intricate).
* The base/material can be done by a merchant separately or at the same time as one of the custom alterations.
*  It is up to the individual merchant if they wish to work on these items.

This item allows you to transfer its appearance onto another compatible worn item by using the TRANSFER verb.  Hold this item in one hand and the target item in your other.  You must repeat the command within 30 seconds to confirm.
Rules:
- Both items must be worn in the same location
- Both items must either be containers or both be non-containers
- If this item is a container, it must be empty before transfer
- The source item is destroyed after a successful transfer
- If the target item has a script, it must be one approved for transmogrification

The Elemental vissi can be added to a vissi artifact in order to augment the artifact with custom abilities.  Each vissi artifact may hold up to 5 different types of vissi, and each vissi may be upgradable by adding additional vissi of the same type to the artifact.

This vissi notes the following ability information:
This vissi casts a spell.  When activated, it will cast Elemental Defense I.  It has 10 charges.

The vissi may have abilities you can activate by using certain verbs (RUB, TAP, PUSH, PULL, or POKE) on the vissi artifact you add them to.  In order to set the activator, use ATTEND on the vissi.  The vissi might not have an ability you may activate, in which case ATTEND will indicate that.

Sometimes, a vissi may have multiple abilities you can activate with the activator verbs.  You can TILT the vissi to switch between them.  Tilt will not respond if the vissi has only a single ability (or no abilities at all).  You may only have one ability active at a time.

In addition, the vissi may have abilities with customizable messaging options.  You can TURN the vissi to customize each set of options.  Once on a set of options, you can TWIST the vissi to cycle through the available customizations.
Finally, some vissi may contain ambient messaging, which you can toggle on or off with COVER.
This vissi is tier 1 and its maximum tier is 1.  It is empowered by 1 thread.
The Elemental vissi will cost 15,000 coins.

It looks like this item has been mainly crafted out of white gold, an infrequent alloy.  This material cannot be dyed.
Analysis of a plain white gold locket with an engraved band of musical notes indicates the creator has provided the following information:

This item allows you to transfer its appearance onto another compatible worn item by using the TRANSFER verb.  Hold this item in one hand and the target item in your other.  You must repeat the command within 30 seconds to confirm.
Rules:
- Both items must be worn in the same location
- Both items must either be containers or both be non-containers
- If this item is a container, it must be empty before transfer
- The source item is destroyed after a successful transfer
- If the target item has a script, it must be one approved for transmogrification
You may also use CLEAN to remove this script from the item, or use DUST to remove its long description, turning it into a plain white gold locket.
You can tell that the locket is as light as it can get, but you might be able to have a talented merchant deepen its pockets for you.
The white gold locket will cost 10,000 coins.
